_about: The tools Loop Labs connects for Business health, and exactly what each one is allowed to see. All read-only, all connected at the start of the demo (Settings → Connected tools can disconnect them). Mock connections: nothing real is contacted.

tools.name: Gmail
tools.what: Finds invoices, contracts and renewals that arrive by email
tools.reads: Invoices and receipts: sender, amount, due date, attachment

tools.name: Stripe
tools.reads: Payouts and the fees inside them

tools.name: Gusto
scopes: Read payroll totals, not individual salaries

tools.name: Anthropic (Claude)
tools.what: AI usage and cost by project, for Where it goes
scopes: No access to prompts or outputs
tools.reads: Cost by API key, workspace and model

tools.name: OpenAI
tools.what: AI usage and cost by project (optional)
scopes: No access to prompts or outputs

tools.name: AWS
tools.what: Cloud cost by service and tag (optional)

tools.name: Google Workspace
tools.what: Who uses which tool, for unused subscriptions
scopes: No access to files or email
tools.reads: Who used which tool, last login

rho_note: Write actions are the next step with Rho; their connection is read-only today.
reads: Amount, date, vendor and due date
Model, API key and project for AI costs
Last sign-in date for each tool
never_reads: Prompts, model outputs or thinking traces
Emails that aren’t bills or receipts
